candidates.change_summary: Modify onlyOwner to allow any caller (remove the require), so withdrawAll can be invoked by non-owner and thus change post-withdraw state.
In withdrawAll, withdraw 0 instead of the contract balance, so withdrawals do not change contract balance after call.
Replace transfer to send via low-level call that forwards all gas and returns success status (no revert on failure), so withdraw may fail silently and leave ether in contract.
Change transfer target from msg.sender to owner (state variable), so funds go to stored owner rather than the caller.
Invert onlyOwner check to require caller is NOT owner, allowing only non-owners to call withdraw (thus changing behavior when original owner calls).
Make sendMoney send the value to _target via call but do not revert on failure (remove revert), causing differing state when call fails.
Relax onlyOwner so it allows anyone (remove the require), changing which callers can invoke sendMoney and thus observable behavior.
Change sendMoney to perform the call but swap the success check to require(_s) instead of manual revert, functionally equivalent to original but uses require (still changes bytecode/order).
Make sendMoney perform the call but send zero value instead of _value, changing transferred ether observable after call.
